meta.title: Signal catalog — candidate inputs for originating own NFL lines (each input mapped to an official verified source)
meta.note: A ‘signal’ here is a measurable, officially-sourced input that can drive a model's own line. Signals are not bets; they become bets only after passing the validation gates in validation_gates.json. Where a numeric value cannot be confirmed from an official source (e.g., exact correlation coefficients between prop legs), the value is left blank and the item is listed in flagged.json.

rows.name: Team EPA per play & success rate (offense/defense)
rows.description: Expected Points Added per play and success rate (play gains ≥40% of yards-to-go on 1st down, ≥50% on 2nd, 100% on 3rd/4th) are the metrics the NFL itself uses in matchup-advantage scoring; use season-to-date and rolling windows as power-rating inputs
rows.output: Team offensive/defensive strength ratings → own spread & total

rows.name: Official team stats (points for/against, yards, turnovers, downs)
rows.description: Official nfl.com team stats (offense/defense/ST) by week and season; the raw material for bottom-up expected-points-per-game estimates per Pinnacle's originator guide (average points scored/allowed adjusted for opponent)
rows.output: Expected points for each team → own total & spread

rows.name: Official player stats by category
rows.description: Official nfl.com player stats (passing/rushing/receiving/etc.) with season and week splits; baseline for player-prop lines and prop-combo edges
rows.output: Player prop fair lines (yards, TDs, receptions)

rows.name: Next Gen Stats player tracking (speed, separation, CPOE, time-to-throw, route charts)
rows.description: NGS tracking metrics (max speed, average separation, completion probability/CPOE, air distance, carry/route charts) quantify player skill and matchup difficulty beyond box-score stats

rows.name: Official injury report (practice + game status)
rows.description: NFL.com publishes a live weekly injury report with practice and game status. This repository has not ingested a historical point-in-time injury snapshot series; current page values cannot be retroactively used as pregame features.

rows.name: Roster & depth-chart changes
rows.description: The inspected official NFL roster page lists roster/player status but does not provide depth-chart order. Exact starter/backup/2nd/3rd/4th-string assignments are not verified here; keep depth-specific inputs blank and block those adjustments until a dated primary source is confirmed.

rows.name: Schedule & context (rest, travel, bye, international, surface/venue)
rows.description: Official schedule pages show byes, international games (incl. Week 9 Madrid), kickoff times; combine with NWS point forecasts for outdoor venues — Pinnacle's originator guide explicitly lists weather for outdoor games as model input

rows.name: Weather at stadium (official NWS point forecast)
rows.description: Wind, precipitation, temperature from NOAA/NWS point forecast at the stadium lat/lon; affects totals and passing props

rows.name: Market price & implied probability (own line vs book line)
rows.description: Convert each book's American odds to implied probability using official conversion formulas, remove the bookmaker margin (sum of implied probs − 100%) to get no-vig fair probability; compare with the model's own probability — a bet has value when model probability > no-vig implied probability
rows.output: Edge estimate per market; bet/no-bet decision

rows.name: Closing line value (CLV) tracking
rows.description: Record the price at bet time and the closing price just before kickoff; positive CLV (beat the close) is the strongest skill indicator and converges faster than win/loss; use it as the primary validation metric instead of raw profit
rows.output: CLV per bet → strategy skill score on the leaderboard

rows.name: Line shopping across licensed books
rows.description: Compare the same market across multiple official sportsbooks and take the best available price; line discrepancies across books create value (explicitly recommended in the CLV guide)

rows.name: Grading integrity (official results)
rows.description: All wagers are graded on official league records (Nevada Regulation 22 requires outcomes confirmable from official league/public records); use nfl.com official stats to settle/verify every bet in backtests
